name: Gladiator Chronicles
source:
A gladiator slave who has lost his family has only two paths: to accept his fate, or to become a great warrior before whom space, time, and the New Roman Empire will bow. Which path will you choose?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Gladiator_Chronicles]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
失去家人的角斗士奴隶只有两条路：接受命运，或者成为一名伟大的战士，空间、时间和新罗马帝国都会向他屈服。你会选择哪条路？

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Gladiator_Chronicles]romance-club.fandom[/url]
